description: Find the tools, MCP servers, APIs and agents that can do something you can't do yourself, from live data to sending, booking or buying, each tested by Alonzio and ranked by whether it works now. Each result says how to call it, whether it needs your own key, and, for look-ups, how to get its answer through use. To get an answer straight away, call answer instead. Free, no key.
